alt: A broad landing in four material schemes—aubergine limewash, cream plaster, walnut panelling, and mirror panels—each with amber stained-glass pendant lights, cream and aubergine furniture, and winter sun raking across the floor.
text:
the amber light stays. the walls shift.

aubergine limewash reads it one way. cream plaster another. walnut panelling catches it differently still. the mirror panels double it back.

winter sun, same rooflight, same Victorian furniture — the materials are what change how the amber glass lands.
